content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding without a redline.

input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: Searches for most-favoured-nation, best-terms, "no less favorable", right-to-match, and comparable-customer pricing language returned nothing, and the responsive locations confirm the absence: § 4.1 Charges simply provides that Charges are specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms with no benchmarking or best-terms undertaking by Customer; § 13.3 Amendments is a plain mutual written-amendment clause; and § 14.16 Freedom of Action expressly states that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," which is inconsistent with any obligation on Bluefly to extend IBM terms given to third parties. The definitions and the balance of the agreement likewise contain no disclosure, matching, or best-pricing mechanic running against Customer. The agreement therefore meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening Customer); there is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour, which is a commercial upside we could raise but is not a playbook deviation and is not redlined.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
